observation.command:
mkdir -p /workspace/.build-logs && cd /workspace && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cat > /workspace/.build-logs/run_build.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# usage: run_build.sh <tag> <context> <dockerfile> [extra build args...]
tag="$1"; ctx="$2"; df="$3"; shift 3
DUMMY_USER=x DUMMY_TOKEN=x DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build \
  --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=DUMMY_USER \
  --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=DUMMY_TOKEN \
  "$@" -t "$tag" -f "$df" "$ctx" >> "/workspace/.build-logs/$tag.log" 2>&1
echo "$? $tag" >> /workspace/.build-logs/results
EOF
chmod +x /workspace/.build-logs/run_build.sh
nohup /workspace/.build-logs/run_build.sh frontend /workspace/01-frontend 01-frontend/Dockerfile >/dev/null 2>&1 &
nohup /workspace/.build-logs/run_build.sh demospipes-base-api /workspace 02-backend/demospipes/api/Dockerfile >/dev/null 2>&1 &
nohup /workspace/.build-logs/run_build.sh demospipes-base-executors /workspace 02-backend/demospipes/core/Dockerfile >/dev/null 2>&1 &
nohup /workspace/.build-logs/run_build.sh dokumentenpruefung /workspace 02-backend/dokumentenpruefung/Dockerfile >/dev/null 2>&1 &
nohup /workspace/.build-logs/run_build.sh mfe-ewm /workspace/01-frontend/mfe-ewm mfe-ewm/Dockerfile >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 5; ls /workspace/.build-logs/; docker ps | wc -l
